description: Implement `Extract(ExtractRequest{module_path}) → Graph` against `golang.org/x/tools/go/packages` using a fixed load mode that returns files, packages, top-level declarations (types, funcs, vars, consts, interfaces, methods), and import edges plus intra-package symbol references; byte-stable serialization for identical inputs.

requirements.description: Implement the Extract(ExtractRequest{module_path}) → Graph operation using golang.org/x/tools/go/packages with a fixed load mode (NeedFiles | NeedImports | NeedTypes | NeedSyntax | NeedTypesInfo | NeedName | NeedDeps). The operation must return all files, packages, top-level declarations (types, funcs, vars, consts, interfaces, methods), import edges, and intra-package symbol references. Output serialization must be byte-stable: identical inputs must always produce byte-for-byte identical output regardless of execution order or timing.
requirements.title: Deterministic Graph Extraction via golang.org/x/tools/go/packages

validation.notes: Table-driven tests for each declaration kind (type, func, var, const, interface, method) to verify correct node creation
Test that the fixed load mode flags (NeedFiles | NeedImports | NeedTypes | NeedSyntax | NeedTypesInfo | NeedName | NeedDeps) are always applied and never overridable by callers
Test byte-stable serialization: run Extract twice on the same fixture, assert JSON output is byte-for-byte identical
Test that import edges are correctly extracted and deduplicated
Test that intra-package symbol references are captured and represented as edges
End-to-end Extract call against go-cycles fixture returns expected nodes and edges matching expected-graph.json byte-for-byte
End-to-end Extract call against go-mislocated fixture returns expected nodes and edges matching expected-graph.json byte-for-byte
Concurrent Extract calls on the same path return identical graphs
Extract on a module with 200 files completes within 5 seconds end-to-end including Connect-RPC transport
Extract completes in <5 seconds for scenarios with ≤200 source files, measured end-to-end including Connect-RPC transport
Extract completes in <30 seconds for scenarios with ≤2000 source files, measured end-to-end including Connect-RPC transport
Golden-fixture extraction reproduced from a clean clone produces byte-for-byte identical output to the committed expected-graph.json
CI gate fails if any fixture's extracted graph diverges from the expected file

title: Deterministic Graph Extraction
